episodes.overview: Captaincy task: Students face tough teachers. Himanshi's betrayal, Asim-Shehnaz clash. Apples decide nominations.

episodes.name: Captain Himanshi pe Bigg Boss ka vaar!
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss slams Himanshi, Paras gloats. Shefali defends Himanshi in fiery clash.

episodes.name: Paras-Asim's rift goes out of control!
episodes.overview: Luxury budget task sparks huge Asim-Paras row. Paras's relationship with Mahira crumbles.

episodes.name: Sidharth aur Shehnaz, dono huye naraaz!
episodes.overview: Day 87: Shehnaz Kaur goes berserk, as she rants against Sidharth Shukla for his attitude towards her lately. While Sidharth tries to make Shehnaz understand, she loses her cool yet again and goes on to accuse him of jeopardizing her game in the house. But with the two paired together in the Mission Mangal Graha task, will their conflict of interest interfere with their performance?

episodes.name: Bigg Boss Christmas 'celeb'-ration!
episodes.overview: Day 88: As the housemates reel from the sudden exit of Vikas Gupta from the show, they are treated to a fun evening as Bigg Boss celebrates Christmas eve with a tasty and celebrity-filled task. However, things begin to go awry as one of their guests turns out to be Jasmin Bhasin! Watch the exciting episode to find out how her relationship with Sidharth Shukla and Rashami Desai will affect the task and the overall game.

episodes.name: Paras duvidha mein!
episodes.overview: Day 89: Paras Chhabra is left teary-eyed when he receives a heart-warming gift of delicious home-cooked food, delivered by Mumbai's famous dabbawalas. However, he is soon left in a dilemma when he has to choose his priorities during the captaincy task between Shehnaz Kaur and Vishal Aditya Singh. With his favourite, expensive yellow shoes at stake, what will Paras do?

episodes.name: Madhurima ke nakhre, captain hui behaal!
episodes.overview: Day 90: Shehnaz Kaur is left raging when the housemates end up sleeping constantly despite the wake-up call being played several times throughout the morning. Further, when a rebellious Madhurima Tuli flatly refuses from complying with the captain's rules and not performing her share of kitchen duties, a furious Shehnaz gives her three punishments, one involving her make-up. Watch this episode to see if this volatile altercation between the two ladies leads to a heated catfight.

episodes.name: Rohit Shetty tames the alphas!
episodes.overview: Day 91: The housemates are left both shocked and divided as Asim Riaz and Sidharth Shukla have yet another bitter war of words between themselves! Soon a shocking surprise entry by ace director Rohit Shetty who demands a private audience with Asim and Sidharth! What exactly happens during their conversation that leaves Shuklaji in tears and Asim repenting, culminating in an emotional bear hug between the two alphas?

episodes.name: Naye saal ki shaandar shuruaat!
episodes.overview: Day 94: Forgetting their woes, worries, and altercations, the housemates gear up in complete swag and style for a special New Year celebration. Graced by some of the most popular faces of Colors, gear up with your favorite housemates for this exciting party! Also, don't miss out on Rashami Desai's emotional outburst as Arhaan Khan gets a special New Year surprise by Bigg Boss in this joyous episode.

episodes.name: Mahira-Shehnaz ki dosti ka the end?
episodes.overview: Day 95: Vishal Aditya Singh and Mahira Sharma begin their new year with a Bigg bang as they get at each other's throats about the latter's assigned chores. However, Mahira is left upset when Shehnaz Kaur does not stand up for her and expresses her displeasure about the same. But with a special power to affect the nominations given to Shehnaz by Bigg Boss, how will their tiff affect Shehnaz's final decision? Don't miss out on this and much more in this fun episode.

episodes.name: Madhurima makes the rules!
episodes.overview: Day 96: Bigg Boss gives the housemates another chance to gain some luxury points by dividing them into two teams and instructing Madhurima Tuli to supervise over the task. However, trouble brews when Siddharth Shukla accuses her of making her own rules in the task, resulting in a frenzy of discord between the two teams. Will Madhurima be able to handle the pressures of running a task? Catch the drama unfold in today's episode.

episodes.name: Rishtein mein aayi kadwahat?
episodes.overview: Day 97: Drama overflows between best friends as Mahira Sharma faces Paras Chhabra's wrath for slapping and Sidharth Shukla pushes Shehnaz Kaur when she irritates. Will they be able to overcome the issues plaguing their relationship? Also, catch world-renowned astrologer Prem Jyotish, as he reveals what the future holds for the housemates.

episodes.name: Vishal-Madhurima ka mahayudh!
episodes.overview: Day 100: Vishal Aditya Singh and Madhurima Tuli get into a heated altercation, leaving the housemates in a state of shock. Things take a shocking turn when a furious Vishal demands action against Madhurima for when she flung her slipper at him in anger. However, a shocker awaits the two as Bigg Boss announces that either one of them will have to leave the house! Will the two set their ego aside and reconcile or will a decision by Bigg Boss end their game?

episodes.name: Mahira ka naseeb, Shehnaz ka khel!
episodes.overview: Day 101: Post their bitter altercation, Vishal Aditya Singh and Madhurima Tuli have an emotional and heart-warming reunion, leaving the housemates relieved. Further, the nominations activity puts Mahira Sharma in a tight spot as a turn of events regarding her nomination depends on Shehnaz Kaur's decision. Following the cold war between the two ladies post Sidharth Shukla's taunts the previous day, will Shehnaz save Mahira? Watch the excitement-filled episode to find out.

episodes.name: Trio gets a Bigg punishment!
episodes.overview: Day 102: Things get better as the housemates who indulged in tiffs, Vishal Aditya Singh-Madhurima Tuli, Shehnaz Kaur-Sidharth Shukla and Paras Chhabra-Mahira Sharma, begin to reconcile. Meanwhile, the captaincy task by Bigg Boss leaves the contestants perplexed as they are forced to choose between themselves and their rivals. Also, don't miss out on a shocking punishment for Asim Riaz, Paras and Mahira at the end of the captaincy task.

episodes.name: Vikas Khanna's healthy food challenge!
episodes.overview: Day 103: The housemates have their jobs cut out for them as they are tasked with the daunting challenge of preparing a healthy and delicious meal for the world-renowned Michelin star chef, Vikas Khanna. Will they be able to impress him? But it's not all hunky-dory as a bitter fight erupts between Mahira Sharma and Shehnaz Kaur as the latter tries to enforce Bigg Boss' punishment to Mahira, Asim Riaz and Paras Chhabra! Will the trio succumb to her demands?

episodes.name: Comedy neh pakada, Paritosh neh jakada!
episodes.overview: Day 104: Funnyman Haarsh Limbachiyaa visits the housemates and mentors them for a fun night of stand up comedy. Ace comedian and stand-up artist Paritosh Tripathi spreads glee as he hosts and heads the stand-up comedy session. Watch the housemates as they royally roast each other to earn the coveted title of winner of this fun-filled activity.

episodes.name: Hina comes with a special surprise!
episodes.overview: Post her confrontation with Salman Khan, Shehnaz Kaur chooses to not interact with the housemates. After many unsuccessful attempts, Sidharth Shukla consoles a sulking Shehnaz, who finally makes a startling revelation about her feelings for him! Meanwhile, Hina Khan aka Sher Khan visits the housemates with a surprise, the BB Elite Club! What is this BB Elite Club? Find out in today's entertainment-packed episode.

episodes.name: Shuklaji ne kiya sanchalakon par vaar!
episodes.overview: Day 108: Asim Riaz makes history as he becomes the first member of the coveted BB Elite Club against Shehnaz Kaur. Meanwhile, a fun luxury budget task goes awry when Sidharth Shukla has an explosive altercation with the moderators of the task, Shefali Jariwala and Arti Singh! Faced with two of his closest friends from outside the house, can Shuklaji control his temperament this time? Watch this entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Vishal-Madhurima wreaks controversy!
episodes.overview: Day : 109: The tiff between Vishal Aditya Singh and Madhurima Tuli takes a shocking turn when an irate Madhurima thrashes him with a frying pan, not once but four times. A furious Bigg Boss chides the two for their unprofessional behaviour and gets them jailed. While Madhurima accepts the punishment, a rebellious Vishal refuses to abide by Bigg Boss' rules and demands to quit the show. Will he stick to his decision after learning of the repercussions?

episodes.name: Parag ki dhamki, Asim ki chuppi!
episodes.overview: Day 110: The contestants in the house go through an emotional spree as they are surprised by their family members visiting the house. With Mahira Sharma over-joyous to see her mother to Shehnaz Kaur's lovely father-daughter moment, the house is filled with happy smiles. But the gala turns gloomy when Parag Tyagi, Shefali Jariwala's husband threatens Asim Riaz for his rude remarks and for misbehaving with his wife. Don't miss out on the thrilling episode.

episodes.name: Maa ko dekh, bacche bane Shuklaji!
episodes.overview: Day 111: Sidharth Shukla's 'angry, young man' image shatters as his mother's entry during the captaincy task leaves him sobbing like a little boy. Meanwhile, Rashami Desai's nephew and niece visit her with a special request - 'Sidharth uncle se dosti karlo!'. Will this adorable request from the tiny tots compel Rashami and Sidharth to re-ignite their dwindling friendship? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Sidharth-Asim lock horns, once again!
episodes.overview: Day 114: Sidharth Shukla's temperament hits the skies when a heated altercation between him and Asim Riaz breaks out during the BB Elite Club task. From physical nudges to violent threats, angry accusations to name-calling, watch the tensions rise between the two. While Bigg Boss sternly announces that the two stay away from each other, all attempts to maintain peace go haywire when they completely disregard his orders. What will the outcome of such disrespect be? Find out.

episodes.name: Rashami-Arti bani sherniyaan!
episodes.overview: Day 115: Hina Khan is back in the house with a special task to find the next member of the BB Elite Club. While Rashami Desai and Arti Singh prove their mettle by tackling the uphill task like fierce lionesses, Sidharth Shukla and Asim Riaz's brawl goes out of hand as they begin arguing mid-task. With the female housemates acing Hina's task, will their heroic efforts be overshadowed by the alpha's roars? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Rotiyon pe chidi Rashami-Mahira ki jung!
episodes.overview: Day 116: A war of words between Rashami Desai and Mahira Sharma regarding cooking duties leaves the housemates split in half on who's cooking they want to eat. Meanwhile, Shehnaz Kaur's attempts to reconcile with Sidharth Shukla goes haywire as the latter distances himself from her. Will this act of Shuklaji push Shehnaz to her breaking point?

episodes.name: Vishal ne diya Shefali ko dhoka!
episodes.overview: Day 117: Vishal Aditya Singh's decision to use his powers as the moderator of the captaincy task to help his alliance has everyone in the house shocked and scratching their head. But the angriest of them all is Shefali Jariwala who makes her displeasure known and blatantly proclaims that she will not listen to him. What will be the repercussions of their action? Watch the masala-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Toot gaya Arti ke sabar ka baandh!
episodes.overview: Day 118: The housemates are in a dilemma when they are asked to choose two names of the contestants who aided in nullifying the tasks to date. Later, Arti Singh is left shattered when she hears something malicious mentioned about her in the house. While a mortified Arti demands to meet Bigg Boss, she is left shocked when Vishal Aditya Singh reveals that he was the person who bad-mouthed her. What will be the outcome of this startling revelation? Watch the episode to find out.

episodes.name: Shuklaji bitten by the jealousy bug!
episodes.overview: Day 121: Sidharth Shukla feels jealous and unhappy that Shehnaz Kaur has decided to side with his rivals in the house and makes his displeasure known. Meanwhile, Bigg Boss continues to teach the housemates a lesson for disregarding the rules of the house and drops a bombshell, inciting a clash between Paras Chhabra and Vishal Aditya Singh. With the threat of nominations looming over their heads, how will this new revelation change the game?

episodes.name: Asim ne khola apna dil!
episodes.overview: Day 122: There is an air of happiness and celebration in the Bigg Boss house as the housemates get a visit from certain special someones from their life. However, the happiest of them all is Asim Riaz as his connection is revealed to be none other than Himanshi Khurana. With Asim confessing his love for her and getting on his knees to pop the question, will his love story have the perfect ending? Watch the exciting episode to find out.

episodes.name: A love triangle in the making?
episodes.overview: Day 123: The housemates are more than pleased to have their respective connections support them while inside the house. Bhabhi Kashmira Shah reveals to Nanad Arti Singh that she sees an ideal groom for her in Sidharth Shukla and speaks of how he has always been there for her in the game. However, with the sparks of friendship igniting between Sidharth and Rashami Desai, is this a possible love triangle in the making? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Connections in total confusion!
episodes.overview: Day 124: The housemates are given an opportunity to take a trip down memory lane with a special task by Bigg Boss. Divided into two teams, the housemates recreate some hilarious moments spent in the house during the season for their respective connections to judge. While the guests are plagued with the decision of supporting their respective connections, will they successfully come to a mutual consensus and decide the winners? Watch this entertainment-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Himanshi ne khole kuch ankahe raaz!
episodes.overview: Day 125: Vikas Gupta lives up to his mastermind tag as he manages to steal the currency from right under Shehbaz Badesha's nose, thus changing the dynamics of the captaincy task. Meanwhile, as the rest of the house is abuzz with discussions about Himanshi Khurana and Asim Riaz's relationship, the former leaves Rashami Desai shocked when she makes a startling revelation about Asim and her relationship with him. What does Himanshi reveal? Watch this and more in today's exciting episode.

episodes.name: OMG! Vikas knocks out Himanshi!
episodes.overview: Day 126: Amidst the frenzy and chaos of the captaincy task, an unintentional physical contact by Vikas Gupta leaves Himanshi Khurana unconscious and in danger. Asim Riaz and the rest of the housemates rush her for medical aid as Bigg Boss calls off yet another task due to the housemates' actions. With the tasks called off and a spot to the finale left unfilled, how will Bigg Boss improvise the game and fill the same?

episodes.name: Housemates vs journalists!
episodes.overview: Day 129: With the finale right around the corner, the housemates get a chance to learn about the impact that they have made in the outside world and explain their side of the story as they come face to face with a slew of reporters and their sharp questions. From Rashami Desai's relationship status to the truth behind Shehnaz Kaur's flip character, watch the contestants as they face the journalists' hard-hitting questions.

episodes.name: The end of #Sidnaaz?
episodes.overview: Day 130: Shehnaz Kaur loses her cool when Sidharth Shukla sides with Paras Chhabra as he mentions that she will flip her friendship with him and get into a live-in relationship with Asim Riaz during the final two weeks of the show. Meanwhile, the housemates are taken aback when a startling revelation by Bigg Boss regarding the final nominations puts them all in danger. What is it that Bigg Boss reveals? Watch the masala-packed episode to find out.

episodes.name: Ulti pad gayi Shehnaz ki chaal!
episodes.overview: Day 131: The members of the BB Elite Club, Sidharth Shukla, Asim Riaz and Rashami Desai find their immunity at stake as the remaining housemates perform a task to snatch it away. Meanwhile, Shehnaz Kaur manages to convince Rashami to announce Mahira Sharma and Paras Chhabra out of the game owing to their negligence. With Paras going berserk over the development and launching a direct attack on Shehnaz and Arti Singh, has Shehnaz's strategy backfired?

episodes.name: Rashami ne lagaya Bigg Boss pe ilzaam!
episodes.overview: Day 132: Rashami Desai gets furious when she is physically hurt by Sidharth Shukla's aggressive demeanour during the nominations task. Angered, Rashami accuses Bigg Boss of being partial towards Sidharth and not taking a stand when he becomes aggressive during the tasks. Also, what exactly does Sidharth do mid-task that leaves Paras Chhabra emotional and in tears? Watch the drama-filled episode to find out.

episodes.name: Kick-starting a healthy day with Shilpa!
episodes.overview: Day 133: The housemates wake up to a fresh day as Shilpa Shetty visits them with a fun Yoga activity. While the housemates work towards clearing their minds off all negativity and gloom. Later, seated with Shilpa, the housemates reminisce some of the best and worst moments of their journey in the show. Watch this and more in today's heart-warming episode.

episodes.name: Rajat Sharma's Bigg Adalat!
episodes.overview: Day 136: The housemates receive a Bigg surprise as renowned journalist and Padmabhushan awardee Rajat Sharma enters the Bigg Boss house on a mission to find the truth behind the accusations that they face. From the truth behind Sidharth Shukla's relationship with Shehnaz Kaur and Rashami Desai to Asim Riaz's explosive behaviour, will the housemates be able to justify their actions? Tune in to find out in today's electrifying episode.

episodes.name: #Sidnaz ki sachayi!
episodes.overview: Day 137: It is time for Shehnaz Kaur to face Rajat Sharma and the accusations levied against her by the audience. From the truth of her relationship with Sidharth Shukla to that of her real persona, watch the exciting episode as Shehnaz tells her side of the story. Also, find out what spooky and shocking surprise Bigg Boss has planned for the housemates with Paras Chhabra's help!

episodes.name: Shh... Bhoot aaya, buri khabar laya!
episodes.overview: Day 138: The housemates are left in shock as Vicky Kaushal enters the house at midnight to promote his upcoming film, Bhoot Part One: The Haunted Ship. However, the excitement soon turns to suspense as Arti Singh, Shehnaz Kaur and Mahira Sharma face the heat of a shocking midnight eviction! Also, join in on Arti and Sidharth Shukla's joy as they watch a video tribute of their journey in the game amidst their excited fans in this excitement-packed episode.

episodes.name: A stroll down the memory lane!
episodes.overview: Day 139: With the highly anticipated grand-finale just around the corner, the housemates witness an extreme dose of nostalgia when a video tribute is played for them individually amidst cheering crowds! Watch your favourite housemates as they are bombarded with overwhelming emotions of joy, grief, warmth and contentment as they witness the up's and down's of their four-month journey in today's nostalgia-evoking episode.

episodes.name: And the winner is!!!!!!
episodes.overview: Kya apka favourite contestant jayega final 3 mein? Watch the grand finale to find out.

episodes.name: Kaun banega Bigg Boss?
episodes.overview: Entertainment and nail-biting suspense! Watch your favourites inch closer to the Bigg moment.

episodes.name: Bhai ne ki gharwalon ki tagdi dhulai!
episodes.overview: Day 92: The housemates are left both shocked and embarrassed when an irate Salman Khan enters the house and begins cleaning the mess left behind them. However, his anger soon fades away when he gets an elaborate and heartfelt dedication on the occasion of his birthday by Bigg Boss and the housemates. Watch their spectacular performance that Salman himself deems 'the best tribute of all seasons' in this fun episode.

episodes.name: Celebration galore for Salman!
episodes.overview: Day 93: Sunny Leone visits the stage and extends her wishes to Salman Khan for several joyous reasons; the immense success of Dabangg 3, the birth of his niece Ayat, his birthday and most importantly, for the approaching New Year! Also, some new revelations about the professional aspects of the age-old enmity between Sidharth Shukla and Rashami Desai during the Vivo Call of the Week lead to a bitter altercation between the two, yet again!

episodes.name: Search for Kajol-Ajay's Jodi No.1!
episodes.overview: Day 98: Ajay Devgn and Kajol visit Bigg Boss to promote their upcoming period film, Tanjhaji - The Unsung Warrior! Enjoy Kajol's hilarious antics as she organises for a special lie detector test for both hubby Ajay, and Salman Khan. Also, don't miss the couple's special test for the Jodi No 1 of the house. With Paras Chhabra and Mahira Sharma competing against Sidharth Shukla and Shehnaz Kaur, which couple will bag the title of 'Ghar ki Jodi No. 1'?

episodes.name: Queen Kangana ne liya Bhai se Panga!
episodes.overview: Day 99: The supremely talented Kangana Ranaut visits Salman Khan and the housemates to promote her upcoming flick Panga! From recreating some iconic scenes to some interesting chit-chat, watch Kangana as she takes some serious Panga with Bhai. Further, with Shefali Bagga and Madhurima Tuli facing nominations, the housemates are left shocked when they are given the power by Bigg Boss to save one housemate from the dreaded eliminations. Who will it be? Find out in today's episode.

episodes.name: Ghar mein aayi Laxmi, layi khushi!
episodes.overview: Day 105: As the dust settles from the hilarious Comedy Club, the housemates are delighted to meet the strong and inspirational Laxmi Agarwal, the acid attack survivor. Moved by her story, join the housemates as they reveal some of the darkest secrets of their life. Also, the gorgeous Deepika Padukone and Vikrant Massey treat some of the housemates to a never before surprise in the history of Bigg Boss in this inspirational episode.

episodes.name: Laxmi ki kahani, Deepika ki zubani
episodes.overview: Day 106: Deepika Padukone, Vikrant Massey, and the inspiration for the film Chhapaak and acid attack survivor, Laxmi Agarwal visit Salman Khan with a very important message. While Salman and Deepika indulge in a fun fruit salad competition, Laxmi campaigns for a ban on the sales of acid. Also, a task between Shehnaz Kaur and Mahira Sharma goes awry, resulting in the former having a shocking outburst in front of Bhai. Will her disrespectful action towards Salman cost Shehnaz her spot in the game?

episodes.name: Paras-Madhurima pe toota Bhai ka keher!
episodes.overview: Day 112: Salman Khan is left fuming with Paras Chhabra's tone and attitude regarding his relationship with Mahira Sharma and his girlfriend outside the house. Meanwhile, Madhurima Tuli faces the wrath for her unprofessional behaviour towards Vishal Aditya Singh, Shehnaz Kaur is on cloud nine as she gets the golden opportunity to interact with her idol, Gautam Gulati! Watch this and more in today's entertainment-packed Weekend ka Vaar.

episodes.name: Bigg Boss ke ghar, Love Aaj Kal!
episodes.overview: Day 113: The contestants in the Bigg Boss house are ecstatic as they see Kartik Aaryan and Sara Ali Khan enter the house. Amidst games and playful banter, the duo manages to see some Love Aaj Kal-type bonds. Tune in to this epic episode as the housemates get into yet another verbal spat.

episodes.name: Bhai ne dikyhaya Sid-Asim ko dwar!
episodes.overview: Day 119: The housemates wake up to Himesh Reshammiya, who visits them with a fun activity to promote his film, Happy Hardy and Heer. Later, unable to tolerate Sidharth Shukla and Asim Riaz's constant threats to each other, Salman Khan opens the doors, asking them to fight each other outside. Will the two alphas of the house do the dreaded deed? Also, don't miss out on Saif Ali Khan and Alaia Furniturewalla who visit Salman Khan to promote their upcoming flick, Jawaani Jaaneman.

episodes.name: BB house turns dance floor!
episodes.overview: Day 120: Salman Khan greets Remo D'Souza, Varun Dhawan and Shraddha Kapoor and the rest of the cast of Street Dancer 3D on stage. While the trio spends some time playing some hilarious games with the housemates, they also perform an iconic dance step with Bhai! However, while the rest of the house dance and have fun, Paras Chhabra is a constant state of worry as the threat of elimination looms over his head. Will this be the end of his run in the house, or does someone else face the exit door?

episodes.name: Rashami ko laga Himanshi ka jhatka!
episodes.overview: Day 127: Salman Khan leaves Rashami Desai dumbstruck when he plays a clip of Himanshi Khurana making some shocking revelations about her and Arhaan Khan's relationship. Following the revelation, Rashami flares up at Asim Riaz's insensitivity, as he blindly supports Himanshi despite being unaware of the situation! Also catch a fun interaction between Hina Khan and Salman Khan as the former promotes her upcoming flick, Hacked.

episodes.name: Somvaar ka vaar with team Malang!
episodes.overview: Day 128: Anil Kapoor, Disha Patani, Kunal Khemu and Aditya Roy Kapur from Team Malang visit the BB house and conduct a fun task for the housemates. Also, with just two weeks remaining, which housemate will face the heat of the dreaded eliminations - Shehnaz Kaur or Vishal Aditya Singh? Watch this intriguing episode to find out.

episodes.name: Shilpa-Salman ne ki yaadein taaza!
episodes.overview: Day 134: Shilpa Shetty Kundra announces her return to films after a sabbatical of thirteen years with Nikamma starring Shirley Setia and Abhimanyu Dassani and visits Salman Khan to promote the same. While Shilpa and Salman reminisce their friendship, they indulge in a healthy yet hilarious game with Shirley and Abhimanyu. Also, watch the Weekend ka Vaar episode to see Arti Singh lose her mind and flare at Sidharth Shukla for not prioritising his friendship with her.

episodes.name: Saavdhan! Ghar aaye Ayushmann!
episodes.overview: Day 135: While Ayushmann Khurrana visits Salman Khan to promote his upcoming film Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan with his co-stars Neena Gupta and Jitendra Kumar, Salman welcomes Adnan Sami and partakes in his joy of being awarded the reputed Padma Shri. Also, don't miss out the iconic moment when Salman gets hilariously grilled by reputed television journalist Rajat Sharma in this fun-filled episode.

episodes.name: Grand Premiere
episodes.overview: From actors, singers, models and even real-life couples, a variety of TV stars are all set to star in the show. However, before earning an entry into the house, each contestant has to go through an assessment taken by Bigg Boss seniors.

episodes.name: Sunday Special With Bigg Boss 14
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss' challenge for the Bigg Boss 14 contestants? Impress the seniors and get what you want. Watch out for this fun-filled Sunday Special episode as Gauahar Khan, Sidharth Shukla and Hina Khan torture the housemates for anything and everything.

episodes.name: Jaan Aces The Mohawk Challenge!
episodes.overview: Day 02: Bigg Boss introduces the first task - Entry Pass, a golden opportunity for the four Rejects to enter the BB house. However, Bigg Boss unleashes a twist by asking the Seniors to grill them with gruelling tasks. When Jaan Kumar Sanu is asked to undergo a mohawk haircut, he steps up to the challenge and aces it. Watch this entertaining episode of Bigg Boss 14 as the Seniors take the Rejects on a wild ride.

episodes.name: Siddharth, Gauhar At Loggerheads!
episodes.overview: Day 03: The housemates embrace the immunity task with gusto. While Hina Khan and Gauahar Khan are pampered as Queens, the thief chief Sidharth Shukla makes plans with his team. But things go south when Gauahar and Sidharth have a heated argument regarding the task rules. Will this bitter spat spell the end of the game?

episodes.name: Abhinav's Big Dilemma - Wife Or Immunity?
episodes.overview: Day 04: Abhinav Shukla is delighted when Bigg Boss gives him the option to save his wife Rubina Dilaik from the dreaded nominations. However, there is a catch. To save Rubina from the nominations, Abhinav must relinquish his immunity. Will Abhinav choose his love over his game?

episodes.name: Siddharth, Shehzad's War Of Words!
episodes.overview: Day 05: After Sidharth Shukla eliminates Rubina Dilaik from the oomph-filled dance task, Pavitra Punia, Nikki Tamboli, and Jasmin Bhasin fight it out in the remaining task that involves balancing glasses on a tray. A bitter fight ensues between the girls when Shehzad Deol knocks the glasses off Nikki's plate to help Jasmin win. However, Shehzad's actions don't sit well with Sidharth, who engages in a bitter war of words with him.

episodes.name: Rubina, Abhinav: Together, But Still Apart!
episodes.overview: Day 06: While Abhinav Shukla is delighted by his wife Rubina Dilaik's entry back into the house, he tries his best to convince the housemates to make adjustments in a way that he can share the bed with his wife. Shockingly, when Abhinav requests Senior Sidharth Shukla for help, Shuklaji flatly refuses, citing that it is his decision. While Abhinav and Rubina take the decision sportingly, will it be a reason for bitterness between them?

episodes.name: A Fun Filled Weekend Ka Vaar!
episodes.overview: Gear up for the much-awaited first-ever Weekend ka Vaar of the season. Amidst the building tensions, Salman Khan is ready to school the housemates for their actions over the past week. From the gruelling immunity tasks to Bhai's subtle jibe at the poor show of a few of the housemates to the revelation of a controversy which Eijaz Khan believes, left him marred and to a special advantage for the winner of the immunity task.

episodes.name: Salman's Not So Subtle Warning!
episodes.overview: Day 7: Salman Khan welcomes the star cast of the popular show Choti Sarrdaarni and has a virtual conversation with a few of popular Mumbai Indians players. Bhai's Vaar continues as the contestants indulge in some interesting tasks. While the housemates seem to have taken the game lightly, Bhai begs to differ. Criticising their performance as below par, the housemates and Seniors are left shocked when Bhai makes the announcement about evictions.

episodes.name: Seniors Get A Super Power!
episodes.overview: Day 09: After the revelations at the Weekend Ka Vaar, the atmosphere in the Bigg Boss house turns intense as the freshers reveal their true nature. However, the housemates get the shock of their lives when the seniors get the power to immediately send a fresher home. Who will be the victim of this surprise elimination?

episodes.name: Nikki Not Playing Fair?
episodes.overview: Day 11: After the surprise eliminations, the freshers get a second chance at being safe with the upcoming Mere Angane Me Tumhara Kya Kaam Hai task. With Nikki Tamboli being the supervisor of the task, the game quickly turns into a warzone, and she is blamed for her biased decisions. Will Nikki's decisions result in Big Boss having to intervene?

episodes.name: Rubina In A Frenzy Of Fury!
episodes.overview: Day 12: A sense of secretiveness prevails in the house as the housemates are busy creating strategies to ace the task. But things turn sour when Shehzad Deol calls Nishant Singh Malkani a 'Hijra' in the heat of the moment which leaves Rubina Dilaik fuming with rage, and she demands an apology from him for using the term as a derogatory word. Will Shehzad realise his mistake and apologise?

episodes.name: Privilege Queen Nikki On Leave!
episodes.overview: Day 12: A gloomy and tensed atmosphere prevails in the kitchen when a volatile argument erupts between Nikki Tamboli and Rubina Dilaik as the former uses her Privilege card and refuses to do her chores. Later the freshers' war to win their personal belongings in the new task turn ugly as things get a little more personal.

episodes.name: Volcanic Dangal Between Seniors!
episodes.overview: Day 14: Hell-bent to win the task, Nikki Tamboli and Jasmin Bhasin put every ounce of their blood in the task. But all hell broke loose as the task gets over and a volcanic war erupts between the Sidharth Shukla and Hina Khan as the former accuse her of being bias towards Jasmin Bhasin.

episodes.name: Rubina Takes On The Seniors
episodes.overview: Day 15: Trouble starts at the dawn of a new day as Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla fight for the improper kitchen duties. However, when the seniors intervene, Rubina goes ballistic to put forth her point. Will the seniors bow down to Rubina's solidarity? Stay tuned as Nikki Tamboli gets a reality check with regards to her confirmed status, in today's exciting episode of Bigg Boss 14.

episodes.name: Salman Gives Rubina An Earful!
episodes.overview: Day 16: Rubina Dilaik rebels against Bigg Boss and refuses to take part in the new task considering it as a grave slander, which leaves Salman Khan in a bitter mood and, he gives her an earful that her decision is erroneous. Disgruntled, he states that first time in the history of Bigg Boss he has witnessed such pointless and rebellious attitude in any contestant. Also, watch the high-voltage Bigg Boss 14 Weekend ka Vaar as Salman reveals that the fresher has the right to vote in the elimination.

episodes.name: Siddharth, The Game Changer!
episodes.overview: Day 17: As Salman Khan continues his 'Vaar' on the housemates, he chides them for their faults on the show and praises them for standing out during the week. While Jaan Kumar Sanu, Shehzad Deol, and Abhinav Shukla are put in the spotlight as the bottom three, they are tied at four votes each by the housemates, leaving Sidharth Shukla's decision as a game-changer. Who will Sidharth vote for, and how will his decision affect the game for the freshers?

episodes.name: It's Shuklaji Against The Khan Duo!
episodes.overview: Day 18: A task for the seniors and their teams is announced with the catch that the losing senior and their team will be eliminated from the game. When the housemates struggle to come to a resolution, Bigg Boss asks Gauahar Khan, Sidharth Shukla, and Hina Khan to take this tough decision. Watch this thrilling episode to find out why the Khan duo stands against Shuklaji and refer to his choice and justification as cheating.

episodes.name: Game Over For Siddharth Shukla!
episodes.overview: Day 19: While Sidharth Shukla and his teammates Pavitra Punia and Eijaz Khan face defeat in the task, the trio is evicted from the house. Shockingly, while the housemates express their grief over the eliminations, Pavitra and Eijaz make a surprise entry revealing a new area of the house: the red zone. With new alliances already being formed between the housemates, how will Pavitra and Eijaz's re-entry change the dynamics of the game?

episodes.name: Nikki Senses Betrayal!
episodes.overview: Day 19: The captaincy task stumbles in the very first round when the coordinators, Eijaz Khan and Pavitra Punia fail to make a unanimous decision, forcing Bigg Boss to intervene. This results in both Abhinav Shukla and Jasmin Bhasin's elimination. But the real drama unfolds during the second round when Nikki Tamboli points fingers at her own friends for turning their backs on her. With captaincy on the line, will friendship go for a toss?

episodes.name: Rahul-Pavitra's volatile feud!
episodes.overview: Day 20: Bigg Boss drops a bombshell on the house and mercilessly dismisses Nishant Singh Malkani from the throne of captaincy for violating a major rule of the house. Later, Pavitra Punia loses her temper and gets into a verbal conflict with Rahul Vaidya for besmirching her reputation by spreading a false rumour about her having a crush on Abhinav Shukla. Watch the volcanic feud unfold in this high-intensity episode

episodes.name: Salman's high-intensity Vaar on Jaan!
episodes.overview: Day 21: Jaan Kumar Sanu is put into the spotlight when Salman Khan confronts him for conspiring against and turning his back on his friend Nikki Tamboli! While Salman's revelations about Jaan's betrayal leave Nikki fuming with rage, she leaves no stone unturned and lashes out at him for his deceit! With Nikki finding a new ally in Rahul Vaidya, how will this alliance change the equations of the housemates? Watch this Weekend ka Vaar episode to find out

episodes.name: Salman's triple googly!
episodes.overview: Day 22: While Nora Fatehi and Guru Randhawa spread their magic with a spectacular performance amidst the Dussehra celebrations, Salman Khan introduces the new entrants, Kavitha Kaushik, Naina Singh and Shardul Pandit. As the contestants end up getting into a fierce argument over a task based on their participation in the game, Salman throws a Dussehra googly which leaves both, the housemates and the wild cards shocked! Watch this entertainment-packed episode for all the fun

episodes.name: Rahul's debate on nepotism!
episodes.overview: Day 23: While the captain of the house Kavita Kaushik establishes her authority by assigning duties to the housemates, a vicious feud erupts when Rahul Vaidya accuses Jaan Kumar Sanu of being a product of nepotism! While Rahul justifies his choice of words, he earns the ire of the housemates who openly express their displeasure towards him during the nominations task! Will Rahul's choice of words put his position in the game in jeopardy? Watch this episode to find out

episodes.name: Jasmin goes berserk!
episodes.overview: Day 24: Rahul Vaidya's choice of words puts him in the spotlight again for creating a rift between Nikki Tamboli and Jaan Kumar Sanu. While Rahul's hurtful comment about women earns him the housemates' wrath, he leaves the normally cheerful Jasmin Bhasin furious when he uses his strength in the captaincy task, which Jasmin thought was unwarranted for. Visibly upset, Jasmin lashes out at Rahul violently! Watch this entertainment-packed episode for the events that follow

episodes.name: Rubina-Kavita lock horns!
episodes.overview: Day 25: Amidst the already-prevailing tensions in the house, Rubina Dilaik grows agitated when Captain Kavita Kaushik requests her to cut fruits for her. Rubina rubs Kavita the wrong way when she reminds her of the rights and duties of a captain. All hell breaks loose as Kavita tells Rubina not to display her Faltugiri by arguing with her, and Rubina hits back by calling Kavita a dictator. Watch their pulsating confrontation in this episode

episodes.name: Kavita: Leave me alone, Eijaz!
episodes.overview: Day 26: The housemates sense a turn in the tide as Eijaz Khan becomes the captain of the Bigg Boss house. However, the atmosphere gets heated when the former captain Kavita Kaushik loses her cool and gives Eijaz a piece of her mind for nagging her about the rules of the house. Will Eijaz back off? Catch the drama unfold in this episode

episodes.name: The game-changer swap or stay!
episodes.overview: Day 27: After the heated clash with Kavita Kaushik, Eijaz Khan gets heartbroken and bursts into tears! Later during the game of Swap and Stay, captain Eijaz gets the special right to change the fate of all the contestants. Who will Eijaz save and who will get dumped in the Red Zone? Watch the game-changer episode packed with shocking surprises

episodes.name: Rubina-Abhinav face Salman's wrath!
episodes.overview: Day 28: While the housemates gear up for yet another Weekend ka Vaar, Salman Khan roasts Rahul Vaidya for his comments about nepotism against Jaan Kumar Sanu. Meanwhile, Abhinav Shukla and Rubina Dilaik face Salman's wrath when they justify Jasmin's outburst and criticise Rahul! Watch this seat-gripping episode to see Bhai address some of the sensitive issues like violence, instigation and nepotism, that have plagued the house and the housemates over the week

episodes.name: Eijaz-Kavita's volatile brawl!
episodes.overview: Day 29: Salman Khan welcomes Sunidhi Chauhan as he continues his Vaar on the housemates, amidst the heat of the weekly eviction! While Eijaz Khan and Kavita Kaushik's friendship is left marred by harsh allegations and shocking revelations during a task, the ever-chirpy Shehnaz Gill arrives with a 'Pyar Bhara' surprise for Eijaz and Pavitra Punia! Stay tuned to this entertaining episode as Eijaz swoops Pavitra off her feet as the two leave for their oh-so-romantic date

episodes.name: Double eviction dhamaka!
episodes.overview: Day 30: An unexpected fiasco unfolds when Naina Singh refuses to do her cooking duty over an altercation with Eijaz Khan and the housemates question Eijaz's captaincy. Later, Bigg Boss announces a shocking double eviction and gives the Green Zone contestants the right to evict one contestant and hands the second elimination to the audience vote! Which two contestants will face the sword of deadly double elimination? Tune in to find out

episodes.name: Pavitra is heartbroken!
episodes.overview: Day 32: Pavitra Punia is aghast when Eijaz Khan chooses to save Jasmin Bhasin from the nominations over her! While Pavitra is not satisfied with the reason Eijaz cites for saving Jasmin, Jaan Kumar Sanu also accuses Eijaz of selective favouritism. With Eijaz's paranoia regarding the captaincy getting on the housemates' nerves, what will be the outcome of his altercation with his close friends? Watch this episode to find out

episodes.name: Pavitra takes her revenge!
episodes.overview: Day 33: Pavitra Punia and Eijaz Khan end up in a vicious war of words when Pavitra loses her cool and bumps him with her elbow in rage! While Eijaz chooses Shardul Pandit as his representative in the captaincy task due to his injury, Pavitra takes her revenge on Eijaz by tactically getting Shardul out of the contention to win the task. Tune in for all the drama

episodes.name: Jasmin gets possessive!
episodes.overview: Day 34: While Pavitra Punia is upset about her tiff with Shardul Pandit, she discusses the same with Aly Goni through the phone in his room. Jasmin Bhasin overhears the conversation and interrupts them. Taken aback by Jasmin's sudden intrusion, Pavitra gets into a war of words and accuses Jasmin of being possessive about Aly. Is Jasmin getting too possessive of her friend Aly? Watch this episode to find out

episodes.name: Angels vs devils!
episodes.overview: Day 35: Excitement flourishes in the house as Bigg Boss announces the luxury budget to the winner of the next team battle, The Devils and the Angels. Teamed up as devils, Eijaz Khan, Aly Goni, and Nikki Tamboli make Jaan Kumar Sanu do the dirty work in the restroom and humiliate him. Can the devils manage to break through the imposed calmness of the angels and bag the luxury budget? Tune in to find out

episodes.name: Dance party with Team Remo!
episodes.overview: Day 36: Get ready to enjoy the dance party as ace choreographer and director, Remo D'Souza and his proteges Salman Yusuff Khan, Punit J Pathak and Shakti Mohan grace the stage to promote their new music label company, BLive. The fun reaches its peak when BB couples put on their dancing shoes and strut their funky stuff on the dance floor. Watch the Weekend Ka Vaar episode jam-packed with entertaining performances

episodes.name: Bhai grills the housemates!
episodes.overview: Day 37: Salman Khan continues his Vaar on the housemates as he addresses some prevalent issues in the house. Salman schools Pavitra Punia for her allegations and aggression towards Eijaz Khan and also put the housemates in the spotlight for not intervening in their argument, reminding them of their moral responsibility. Tune in to the episode as Bhai not only grills the housemates but also shocks everyone with the eviction in this Weekend ka Vaar

episodes.name: Farah's court is in session!
episodes.overview: Day 38: Farah Khan, along with two journalists Charrul Malik and Amith Tyagi, enters the house to hold Farah Ki Adalat to judge the contestants based on their journey so far. And in the end, one of the housemates will be nominated for eviction by the trio. Without wasting any time, the judges summon Eijaz Khan and bring up his ongoing conflict with Kavita Kaushik, and she faces the music for her stance. Will Kavita hold her ground and prove her innocence?

episodes.name: Jasmin's emotional dilemma!
episodes.overview: Day 39: While the housemates are recuperating from the shock of Farah Khan's courtroom session, they are hit by yet another shocker, the dreaded nominations task! Jasmin Bhasin is put in a difficult situation when her favourite doll is destroyed by Aly Goni to save Abhinav Shukla. Jasmin then faces the heat when she is asked to nominate her best friend Aly to save Rubina Dilaik. Will Jasmin prioritise Aly over Rubina? Watch Jasmin face her demons in today's episode

episodes.name: Partying all night goes wrong!
episodes.overview: Day 40: Rahul Vaidya takes centre stage and goes down on one knee to romantically propose his girlfriend, Disha Parmar. Later, Bigg Boss throws a surprise all-night disco party with music industry biggies - DJ Chetas, Anu Malik and Neeti Mohan as the special guests. But, the catch here is that it's also a captaincy task! Watch the entertaining party turn into a volcanic verbal fight as Eijaz Khan and Abhinav Shukla lock horns

episodes.name: The test of Captain Aly's patience!
episodes.overview: Day 41: While the housemates dance their way into the race for captainship to the tunes of Shaan and Sachin Trivedi, Aly Goni shines as the new captain of the house. However, Nikki Tamboli is unhappy with Aly's captaincy and decides to go against his rules. She extends her sleep hours despite his constant requests. After several attempts, an annoyed Aly splashes water on her face! How will Nikki react to Aly's shocking act? Watch the episode to find out the events that transpire

episodes.name: Rubina-Abhinav face Bigg Boss' googly!
episodes.overview: Day 42: The housemates must mutually decide any two names for a set of cages placed in the house as a punishment for their unsatisfactory performance during the week. While Jaan Kumar Sanu is targeted by Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla citing time for retrospection, Bigg Boss turns the tables and puts the couple in the cages for modifying task rules. How will Abhinav and Rubina deal with this shocking twist of fate?

episodes.name: Game of gifts with Vamps and Divas
episodes.overview: Day 43: On the eve of Diwali, Salman Khan takes the housemates on an emotional roller-coaster ride with gifts from loved ones. To mark the victory of good over evil, Sudha Chandran and Monalisa arrive as Vamps, while Surbhi Jyoti and Mahima Makwana join in as the Divas, who come with a few challenges for the housemates. Will the Divas prevail over the Vamps, or will history change? Tune in to find out in today's episode

episodes.name: High-octane Qawwali battle!
episodes.overview: Day 44: During the Diwali celebration, the entertainment level goes through the roof as the playful banter and rhyming wisecracks of the Qawwali battle makes Salman Khan burst out with laughter. Later, he welcomes Haarsh Limbachiyaa, Garvit Pareek and Surbhi Chandna and the trio plays a fun game with the housemates. But the joyful atmosphere vanishes because of the forthcoming eviction. Watch the epic episode jampacked with entertainment and find out who is going home

episodes.name: A one-of-a-kind nomination
episodes.overview: Day 45: The housemates are taken aback when Bigg Boss announces a special nomination process. Being the captain, Aly Goni is allowed to nominate six housemates for eviction. While the housemates try to convince the nominated housemates to save them, the inner politics continue to change the equations between them. With alliances being made and broken, watch how the nominations change the dynamics of the game, in the episode

episodes.name: Kavita-Eijaz's volcanic fight!
episodes.overview: Day 46: Things don't look any better for Kavita Kaushik inside the BB house as she enters into a heated argument with Aly Goni followed by a volcanic feud with her arch-enemy, Eijaz Khan! But things really escalate to an ugly level when Kavita is forced to commit a physical act of misconduct. Later, the new captaincy task begins as the King of black hearts - Rahul Vaidya wages war against the Queen of red hearts - Rubina Dilaik. Watch the drama unfold in this entertaining episode

episodes.name: Nikki goes breaking hearts
episodes.overview: With captaincy at stake, the housemates, along with the King and Queen, form groups and strategies to gain the upper hand. With no alliances to join and no opportunity of winning the task at hand, Nikki Tamboli sends shockwaves through the Bigg Boss house as she starts smashing the hearts in the garden area before the task begins. Will Nikki's sudden act get her shunned by both teams? Or will Nikki's unusual strategy work for her? Catch the drama unfold in this episode

episodes.name: Jaan faces betrayal!
episodes.overview: Day 48: While Bigg Boss criticises the housemates for squandering the golden chance to become the captain in the previous task, a captaincy task for the four previous captains is announced. Jaan Kumar Sanu loses his cool when Eijaz Khan chooses to make Pavitra Punia his representative owing to his injury. Later, Jaan's temper hits the roof when the housemates put him into a guilt-trip for continuously torturing Kavita. Watch Jaan break down on being betrayed by Eijaz in this episode

episodes.name: The clash of the spouses!
episodes.overview: Day 49: While the captaincy task between Kavita Kaushik and Jasmin Bhasin exceeds twenty-four hours, Rubina Dilaik suggests reaching an agreement between the two and concluding the task. However, Abhinav Shukla is against the idea and refuses to support Rubina in her initiative and advises her against it! Visibly upset, Rubina lashes out at him and implies that he is not participating to his fullest in the task! Watch the couple as they battle it among themselves in this episode

episodes.name: Jaan, a friend for convenience?
episodes.overview: Day 50: Friendships and alliances are put to the test as the housemates are told to name two people who have friendships based on convenience. While Abhinav Shukla is advised to play his own game, Jaan Kumar Sanu is put in the spotlight for making friends with people in power. Will Jaan be able to justify his actions as well as not lose the already earned friends' support? Tune in to find out in today's dramatic Weekend Ka Vaar episode

episodes.name: Ekta's dramatic twist: Immunity Stone!
episodes.overview: Day 51: The Queen of Indian Television, Ekta Kapoor enters the BB house with revenge on her mind and the Immunity Stone in her hands. However, only one contestant can have the game-changing Immunity Stone and, they will have to impress Ekta to win it! Later, Divyendu Sharma And Sumeet Vyas join them in a hilarious roasting session followed by a shocking eviction. Watch the entertaining episode jampacked with drama, humour and a surprise revelation

episodes.name: Rahul locks horns with Eijaz!
episodes.overview: Day 52: During the nomination task, the dirty politics unfolds an aggressive argument between Eijaz Khan and Rahul Vaidya as the latter chooses to break his promise to save him and openly nominate him. Later, a wave of laughter spread across the BB house as Kavita Kaushik gives her justification and housemates laugh to scorn the house captain. Watch the drama unfold in this engrossing episode

episodes.name: Aly wrecks complete havoc!
episodes.overview: Day 53: The housemates are taken aback when Bigg Boss gives Kavita Kaushik the responsibility of confiscating the personal possessions of the housemates whom she feels have broken the rules. While Kavita confiscates Aly Goni's trimmer, things get heated up when she mentions his father's name, leaving him furious! Matters escalate to the point where Aly damages the property and Kavita is hurt in the scuffle. What will be the outcome of this volatile argument? Watch the masala-packed episode to find out!

episodes.name: Rubina-Abhinav turn rebels!
episodes.overview: Day 54: Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla rebel against Kavita Kaushik's captainship by refusing to do their duties and openly break the house rules. Soon, a task titled Batwara is announced where the house is divided into two, and each side has to claim the rights to the house. With Rubina and Abhinav in one team, will Kavita take her revenge against the two for their rebellious attitude or will she play fair? Watch this action-packed episode to find out,

episodes.name: Eijaz in a tight spot
episodes.overview: Day 55: With the housemates split into two teams, the ones who have access to the bedroom dominate the house. Meanwhile, Nikki Tamboli manages to convince Eijaz Khan to let her into the bedroom under the pretext that she is unwell. But Eijaz faces backlash from his teammates for letting her in as she starts collecting all her things before she is forced out of the room. Will Eijaz manage to get her out of the room? Tune in to find out,

episodes.name: Rubina vs Jasmin: The Bigg fight!
episodes.overview: Day 56: The Batwara task leaves the housemates divided and against each other, leaving aside their alliances and friendships. While Jasmin Bhasin and her team win the Batwara task with the right to maximum property, nothing seems right between Jasmin and her good friend Rubina Dilaik. What exactly happened during the task that leaves Jasmin seething in anger and threatening to reveal personal secrets about Rubina and Abhinav Shukla? Watch this episode to find out the details,

episodes.name: Salman announces a Bigg purge!
episodes.overview: Day 57: While Salman Khan opens the Weekend Ka Vaar episode with a bang, the housemates face his questions, criticism and appreciation. Soon, the housemates are left shocked with gaping mouths when Salman makes an unexpected announcement! He announces the grand finale of the season during the coming week with a new and major twist in the game! Watch this thrilling episode to find out for yourself as Bhai makes the revelation,

episodes.name: Aly-Jasmin get roasted!
episodes.overview: Day 58: The Weekend ka Vaar episode opens with Salman Khan welcoming a celebrity guest panel to support their connections. Kamya Punjabi puts Jasmin Bhasin in the spotlight by pointing at her dual personality post- Aly Goni's arrival and advises her good friend Rubina Dilaik to prioritise herself over others! Also, don't miss out on Salman's shocking twist in the form of challengers who will enter the house in the future to make life hell for the housemate! Watch this thrilling episode,

episodes.name: Deepest, darkest secrets revealed!
episodes.overview: Day 58: Bigg Boss drops a bombshell on Rubina Dilaik and announces a new task in which the housemates stand a chance to steal her Immunity Stone. But, to win the Immunity Stone and become the first finalist, the housemates will have to confess their deepest and darkest secrets on national television! Who will win the heart-rending task? Watch the tear-jerking episode as everyone drops their shocking truth bombs,

episodes.name: The eviction task starts a war!
episodes.overview: Day 60: With the finale right around the corner, Bigg Boss announces an eviction task in which the housemates are divided into four teams of two each, and they need to face the infuriating questions of the housemates. During the task, Nikki Tamboli speaks ill of Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla's marriage, which starts a heated argument. Watch the maddening drama and find out which team will get executed by the sword of eviction,

episodes.name: Catfight alert: Rubina vs Kavita
episodes.overview: Day 60: The housemates face the harsh reality when Bigg Boss shows them footage of today's episode where everyone is seen idle, doing nothing productive and napping. Soon, the blame game begins during a task, when Kavita Kaushik and Rubina Dilaik get into a heated argument and go to the extent of pushing and charging towards each other in rage! In a fit of anger, Kavita walks out of the main door! Did Kavita just quit the show? Watch the episode to find out,

episodes.name: Clash of the tough minds!
episodes.overview: Day 62: As the task to win the ticket to the finale commences, all the contestants rush to the boat to dominate the challenge. Things go awry when Abhinav Shukla and Jasmin Bhasin eye the same chair and end up facing each other's wrath! Who will emerge as the final victor? Watch the suspense-filled episode to find out,

episodes.name: Rahul-Eijaz's volatile fight!
episodes.overview: Day 63: Rahul Vaidya and Eijaz Khan have a heated fight while washing utensils in the kitchen area when the former ridicules Eijaz with his one-liners! What begins as an argument soon gets into a major showdown as they two indulge in a mild physical tiff. Later, Rahul is put in the spotlight during an activity when the housemates gang up on him for disrespecting women! With the arrival of the contenders soon, how will this argument affect the housemates? Watch this episode to find out,

episodes.name: A shocker for Nikki!
episodes.overview: Day 64: With the mid-season finale started, Salman Khan gives the housemates a pleasant surprise with a video tribute of each contestant's fondest and harshest memory. However, just when the contestants get comfortable, Salman drops the bomb in the form of Nikki Tamboli being eliminated from the race to the finale. Catch the reactions of the housemates along with the ghosts of the past seasons returning for another chance at the prize, in this dramatic episode,

episodes.name: Rahul Vaidya's shocking exit!
episodes.overview: Day 65: Salman Khan introduces the gorgeous Shruti Sharma who gives a scintillating dance performance and promotes her upcoming show, Namak Ishq Ka. Soon, the housemates and Salman are left shocked when Rahul Vaidya is reduced to tears and voluntarily quits the show citing homesickness. Furthermore, the finalists face their worst nightmare of the season as they meet the six challengers. How will their entry change the dynamics of the game? Watch this gripping Weekend ka Vaar episode to find out,

episodes.name: King for a day: Rahul Mahajan!
episodes.overview: Day 66: An electrifying atmosphere prevails as the challengers make their way inside the BB house one after the other. The mastermind, Vikas Gupta starts plotting his devious games to accomplish the secret task given by Bigg Boss. Later, Rahul Mahajan is made 'The King for One Day' which unfolds new drama in the house. Watch the entertaining episode and join the fun,

episodes.name: Rubina-Eijaz lock horns!
episodes.overview: Day 67: Rahul Mahajan gets the advantage to choose the captain for the week. During the captaincy task, a tiff breaks out between Rubina Dilaik and Eijaz Khan when Rahul chooses the latter. While Rubina does not attempt to convince him, Eijaz gets annoyed and alleges that Rubina does not deserve to be in the game. Furious, Rubina accuses Eijaz of forming alliances according to his convenience! Have the challengers started playing their game against the housemates? Watch this episode,

episodes.name: Warfare situation between Vikas-Arshi!
episodes.overview: When Arshi Khan targets Vikas Gupta for his unusual practices, a volatile feud unfolds and lead to a physical code of misconduct. During the nomination task, things quickly escalate to a nasty level when Arshi mercilessly rubs dirt on Vikas's face, and he loses his cool. The task ends up in a complete frenzy as Rubina Dilaik, and Kashmira Shah accuses Manu Punjabi of being bias. Watch the drama-packed episode filled with heated arguments and entertainment,

episodes.name: Arshi: Vikas, Bigg Boss is not your show!
episodes.overview: Day 69: After Vikas Gupta's team wins the nomination task, he predicts that Arshi Khan will get nominated as she is the weakest contestant in the BB house. Unhappy with his statements, a furious Arshi confronts him and berates him. Things take an ugly turn as their feud goes to a personal level, and they try to blacken each other's reputations. Will Bigg Boss intervene and put an end to this bitter war?

episodes.name: Rakhi brings a jaw-dropping surprise!
episodes.overview: Day 70: The house is filled with an unequivocal amount of joy as Bigg Boss welcomes back the show's oldest contestant after thirteen years, Rakhi Sawant! She stuns the housemates as she brings a giant gift box, and Nikki Tamboli emerges from it. Lastly, the joy tenfolds for Jasmin Bhasin as Aly Goni also returns to the house. With the arrival of three more contestants, how will the game dynamics change? Watch the game-changing episode and find out,

episodes.name: Salman angry with Arshi!
episodes.overview: Day 71: The Weekend Ka Vaar is full of fireworks! Salman Khan is furious with Arshi. What did Arshi say to him that upset him so much? Why did he warn that he would never talk to her again? Plus, Kavita makes some serious allegations against Abhinav.

episodes.name: Rahul back in the game?
episodes.overview: Day 72: The housemates feel the pressure of the Weekend Ka Vaar as fights break out in front of Salman Khan. However, Salman throws an oddball to the game plans of the contestants as Rahul Vaidya returns for another chance, and his fate lies in the approval of the people living in the Bigg Boss house. Will Rahul be welcomed with open arms? Tune in to find out in this episode,

episodes.name: Into the pool, the argument dives!
episodes.overview: Day 72: The growing tension between Arshi Khan and Vikas Gupta reaches a boiling point when he takes a stand against her continuous hammering. Their arguments turn into a blazing inferno when Arshi blackens his relationship with her mother. Unable to bear with Arshi's unwarranted bad-mouthing on his family matters, a disgruntled Vikas loses his temper and unintentionally pushes her into the swimming pool! Watch the volcanic drama erupt in this episode,

episodes.name: Kashmera: Nikki, I will smash your face!
episodes.overview: Day 73: Seeing the budding friendship of Manu Punjabi and Nikki Tamboli, Kashmera Shah questions what's brewing between them, which lights a spark in the house about their growing closeness. Subsequently, when Nikki tries to clear the air with Kashmera, a volcanic feud erupts and the latter threatens to use physical violence against her. Also, watch the entertaining episode as Rahul Vaidya returns to the BB house,

episodes.name: A plan to target Nikki!
episodes.overview: Day 74: Kashmera Shah, Nikki Tamboli, Arshi Khan and Rakhi Sawant battle against each other during the first round of the captaincy task, 'BB Duck Park'. While the three join hands and target Nikki, what results is an ugly fight among the ladies! From hurling abuses, allegations, pushing and pulling the housemates around to biting during the task, the day turns into a wild one. Watch the high-octane drama of the ladies in the race to become the captain, in this exciting episode,

episodes.name: Rahul Eijaz Ka Yudh!
episodes.overview: Day 75: All eyes turn towards Rahul Vaidya and Eijaz Khan when the duo cross swords in the middle of the task. Who will win the war of words? Also, Rakhi Sawant gets the responsibility to oversee the second round of Duck Park Task. While she is busy briefing the contenders, Rubina Dilaik insinuates that Rakhi is the fifth duck, which leaves Arshi Khan furious, and she gives an ultimatum to Rubina for body shaming.

episodes.name: Ali, Jasmine On Rakhi's Target!
episodes.overview: Day 91: Rakhi Sawant questions Aly Goni's friendship with Jasmin Bhasin and an argument breaks out between them. A furious Aly lashes out at Rakhi for insinuating that he has feelings for Jasmin. Later, during a New Year resolution-based task, Rakhi decides to break Jasmin's resolution of keeping the house clean. She even goes to the extent of throwing around bed sheets, mattresses, and even food. How will their rivalry play out?

episodes.name: Salman: What Is This Sign, Rubina?
episodes.overview: Day 91: The first Weekend Ka Vaar of the new year gets a fiery start as Salman Khan chides the housemates for belittling Rakhi Sawant. Salman seems to be in no mood to stop as he confronts Rubina Dilaik for flashing a finger-sign to Arshi Khan after an argument with her. Will Rubina be able to explain her way out of this situation?

episodes.name: Salman Welcomes Sunny Leone!
episodes.overview: Day 92: Salman Khan begins his Vaar by admonishing Jasmin Bhasin for her demeaning remarks against Rakhi Sawant with regards to her cosmetic surgery. Further, Aly Goni faces the heat for his personal attacks on Vikas Gupta. Later, the stunning Sunny Leone helps calm the tense atmosphere in the house as she enters with a fun activity for the housemates.

episodes.name: Abhinav, Rubina At Loggerheads!
episodes.overview: Day 93: While the housemates are in high spirits as they meet and greet members of the Colors family, Mona Lisa leaves them dumbstruck as she announces a shocking eviction. Later, a heated argument erupts between Abhinav Shukla and Rubina Dilaik when the former tries to give her a piece of his mind for joining Jasmin Bhasin and Nikki Tamboli in humiliating Rakhi Sawant. How will this fight affect the dynamics between the couple?

episodes.name: Arshi Targets Rubina!
episodes.overview: Day 94: Making the most of the fact that Rubina Dilaik is directly nominated for evictions by Bigg Boss as a punishment for discussing nominations, Arshi Khan taunts her at every given chance during the day. From accusing Rubina of being egoistic and dominating, to constantly mocking her, Arshi tries her best to break Rubina to the point where Abhinav Shukla decides to intervene. What will be the outcome of this heated argument?

episodes.name: Rubina, Eijaz Cross Swords!
episodes.overview: Day 95: Visibly upset about Nikki Tamboli refusing to clean Rakhi Sawant's bed as part of her bedroom duties, Eijaz Khan raises his objections about the same. With Rubina Dilaik speaking in Nikki's favour, things get ugly when the former accuses Eijaz of manufacturing false narratives about some housemates to tarnish their images before the audiences. Annoyed by their argument in English, a furious Arshi Khan breaks some chairs.

episodes.name: An Emotional Reunion For Nikki!
episodes.overview: Day 96: The announcement of the BB Talktime task leaves the contestants overwhelmed as they get a golden opportunity of interacting with their near and dear ones. Nikki Tamboli, the first chosen contestant, has an emotional reunion with her mother, Pramila Tamboli. From demanding to hug her to sharing her woes, Nikki becomes a little girl as she spends a few precious moments with her mother.

episodes.name: Kyun Ro Padi Rakhi?
episodes.overview: Day 97: The saga of emotion continues, as the housemates meet their close ones. Rakhi gets to meet her mom but is shocked to hear that she has been admitted to the hospital with a severe stomach ache..

episodes.name: A Shocker For Jasmine
episodes.overview: Day 98: Rashami Desai enters the house to support her friend Vikas Gupta and rebukes Jasmin Bhasin and Aly Goni for bullying Vikas and attacking him personally. Later in the day, Jasmin is elated on seeing her parents enter the house. However, their reunion turns into Aly Goni's worst nightmare as they advise her to concentrate on her game and play solo. With the growing closeness between the two, have Jasmin's parents indirectly rejected Aly?

episodes.name: A Shocking Exit!
episodes.overview: Day 99: The contestants welcome Salman Khan into the BB house, but Nikki Tamboli and Rakhi Sawant's continuing feud leaves the entire house embarrassed as they see Salman performing Nikki's duties. This Weekend Ka Vaar ends on a rather emotional note as Jasmin Bhasin's eviction leaves the housemates as well as Salman Khan unsettled.

episodes.name: Salman ka gussa
episodes.overview: Day 126: The housemates are filled with an unequivocal amount of joy as Salman Khan welcomes Disha Patani and Randeep Hooda and announces that his latest film, Radhe is coming to the cinemas this Eid. Later, Salman introduces the eight new celebrities who will play the role of supporter for the housemates. Lastly, the housemate faces Salman's most ferocious and brutal avatar.

episodes.name: Salman lambasts Rubina!
episodes.overview: Day 127: Disgruntled and downhearted, Salman Khan faces the housemates and criticises their actions with great disappointment. But yet again, Rubina Dilaik faces the brutal lambasting from Salman for using foul language and inappropriate behaviour. However, Rubina's sister - Rohini Dilaik, differs from Salman's viewpoint and stands in support of her sister. Also, watch the episode as Rubina opens up about her dark past.

episodes.name: Jasmin returns as Aly's support!
episodes.overview: Day 129: The housemates are in high spirits as their near and dear ones arrive in the Bigg Boss house. While Jasmin Bhasin's arrival has Aly Goni emotional and in tears, she soon leaves the atmosphere tense with her shocking view that Aly looks like Rubina Dilaik's sidekick. Will Jasmin's arrival and words influence Aly, thus causing a rift between his bond with Rubina, or will he stand up against Jasmin's negative opinion about Rubina?

episodes.name: A shocking eviction!
episodes.overview: Day 130: The housemates are taken aback by the announcement of a shocking mid-week elimination whose decision lies in the hands of the supporters. As Devoleena Bhattacharjee, Rahul Vaidya, Nikki Tamboli, and Abhinav Shukla face each other in the elimination, Rubina Dilaik is left sobbing upon hearing the shocking results. Which housemate has fate frowned upon in the final run of their journey in the show?

episodes.name: Ticket to Finale ki jung!
episodes.overview: Day 131: Devoleena Bhattacharjee is on cloud nine with the arrival of Sanskari Playboy, Paras Chhabra, as her supporter. Soon, the housemates are on the alert with the announcement of the Ticket-to-Finale task. While Paras is given the responsibility of taking the final decision in the task, will he do the expected and support Devoleena to secure her position in the grand finale, or does he have a game-changing plan cooking up his sleeve?

episodes.name: Rubina Vs Jasmin: Catfight of the season!
episodes.overview: Day 132: Aly Goni alleges that four contestants were trying to help Rubina Dilaik in the nominations task. While Rubina and Aly have a spat, Jasmin Bhasin steps in to support Aly, leading to an ugly catfight. From Jasmin accusing Rubina of depending on Abhinav Shukla for her survival in the game to Rubina's strong retaliation to Jasmin's allegations, this is one catfight you cannot miss. Watch the friends-turned-foes battle it out in this bitter brawl.

episodes.name: Rakhi's Bigg dilemma!
episodes.overview: Day 133: With Nikki Tamboli in the grand finale, Aly Goni, Rahul Vaidya and Rakhi Sawant get another chance to redeem themselves and secure their positions in the finale. Soon, Rakhi gets a chance to become a finalist by shredding a whopping sum of INR 14 lakhs from the winning sum of INR 50 lakhs. While Aly and Rahul attempt to convince Rakhi otherwise, will she go ahead and shred the money? Watch Rakhi face her demons with this dilemma in today's suspense-packed episode.

episodes.name: Salman's reality check for Rahul
episodes.overview: Day 133: Salman Khan appreciates Rubina Dilaik and Nikki Tamboli for their efforts in the Ticket-to-Finale task. While he congratulates Rakhi Sawant for using her wit and securing her position in the grand finale, he lambasts Aly Goni and Rahul Vaidya for bullying her. As he reprimands the duo, Salman gets even more furious when Rahul screams at Rakhi and leaves her in tears. Watch Salman as he gives the housemates a reality check in the final Weekend Ka Vaar of the season.

episodes.name: Rahul Gets On His Knees!
episodes.overview: Day 134: The atmosphere turns romantic for the first time, as the BB house becomes an abode of three singers who set the mood on Valentine's Day. And the love metre crosses the bar when Rahul Vaidya's girlfriend, Disha Parmar, pays him a surprise visit with her answer to his marriage proposal. Also, as Salman Khan bids goodbye to the last Weekend Ka Vaar episode of the season, he introduces the upcoming dance reality show Dance Deewane.

episodes.name: Rahul, Rubina Share A Cordial Moment!
episodes.overview: Day 135: The housemates welcome some popular RJs into the house. Not known to mince their words, the housemates face some sharp and straightforward questions from the guests. Amidst the Q and A session, Rahul Vaidya sings the popular, Jadu Teri Nazar for Rubina Dilaik on request and the two share a dance, making the moment a treat for the eyes. Have the two let bygones be bygones and extended a hand of friendship towards each other?

episodes.name: Grand Premiere
episodes.overview: The Grand Premiere kicks off the milestone 20th season with host Salman Khan welcoming viewers and introducing the brand-new, dreamscape-themed house built around the concept of "Duality." In this opening episode, Salman Khan introduces the complete lineup of celebrity contestants and digital creators stepping into the house. The episode unveils initial twists, sets the tone for the upcoming weeks of tactical gameplay, and gives audiences their first look at the surreal living zones and the mysterious "Room No. 20.

seasons.overview: Marking its milestone 20th season, India's ultimate reality television phenomenon returns with Salman Khan back as the host. Centered around the theme of "Duality" ("Tathas-Two"), the season plunges a diverse group of celebrities, digital creators, and public figures into a surreal, dreamscape house filled with optical illusions, chaotic living spaces, and surreal art installations like a teapot throne and a shark-themed pool. Under round-the-clock camera surveillance, housemates must navigate shifting alliances, intense weekly tasks, unexpected twists including the high-stakes "Extra Jeevan Daan" lifeline mechanic, and the mystery of the forbidden Room No. 20 to survive the game and claim the trophy.
